text:
maria: Quick idea 1: Green-bowl swap + happy hour at the breakout cafe Thursday 5:30? Bring a salad/grain bowl to share, or just come for drinks. Low-key. :leafy_green: :tada:

jeff: Im in. Can we do a short vote on drink prefs?

maria: Sure 1 react with :cocktail: for cocktails, :beer: for beer-focused, :lemonade: for mocktails only, :bento: if youre just coming for food.

nina: :lemonade: (driving tonight)

arjun: :cocktail: :bento:

maya: :beer: _and_ I will bring a quinoa salad.

jeff: I can bring chopsticks and a couple of serving spoons. Also open to bringing a dip.

maria: Cool. Any strong allergies?

nina: Tree nuts are a no for me.

arjun: Gluten-free option appreciated but not necessary.

maria: Noted. I'll label dishes with allergens.

jeff: Logistics q: is the cafe table big enough for serving? Might need a folding table from storage.

maya: We have a folding table in the events closet, I can grab it at 5pm.

arjun: I'll bring a small tray of chilled mocktail mixers too.

maria: Poll follow-up: looks like cocktails + some mocktails. Plan: bring bowls, small plates, utensils. I'll make a shared checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Green-Bowl Swap + Happy Hour" Thu 17:30  reminder at 14:30.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Green-Bowl Swap & Happy Hour" Thu 17:30  guests updated. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2490012345

maria: If anyone wants to claim a specific item on the checklist (ice, napkins, paper bowls), reply with the item. I'll grab name tags for allergens.

jeff: I'll take ice + napkins.

nina: I'll bring paper bowls and a set of labels.

maya: Table and cups on me.

arjun: Bringing mocktail mixers and a fruit garnish bowl.

maria: Amazing. See you Thursday 1 bring a bowl or just bring yourself. :bowl_with_spoon: :clinking_glasses:
